messages.content: American moved our June 27 flight home ninety minutes earlier. Compare leaving it alone with switching all three of us to the later nonstop. I need the fare difference and what each option does to the transportation timing.

The schedule change moved Q7N4PL from a 12:35 p.m. departure to 11:05 a.m., arriving in Chicago at 5:14 p.m. Keeping it costs nothing. The later nonstop leaves San Diego at 5:40 p.m. and arrives at 11:48 p.m.; three Main Cabin seats are available, and the total additional fare is $267, or $89 per traveler. There is no change fee. I’m checking both options against the ground arrangements now.
The 10:15 hotel pickup clearly will not work for 11:05. How early would we have to leave?

For the 11:05 flight, the transfer company recommends an 7:35 a.m. resort pickup, allowing for the drive, bag drop, and security. They can move the booking without charge. The 5:40 p.m. flight would call for a 2:35 p.m. pickup instead.
And the rental? I had in mind that we would be dealing with the car that morning too.

The confirmed Enterprise SUV is due back June 25 at 4:00 p.m., two days before departure, so neither flight changes that reservation. The branch shuttle after the return also remains as booked. On June 27, only airport transfer SDT-627104 needs to move.
Right, I mixed up the dates. So the real comparison is $267 to keep most of Friday versus no added cost and leaving the resort at 7:35.

Correct. The earlier flight saves $267 but takes away the final morning and requires the 7:35 a.m. pickup. The later nonstop preserves breakfast, checkout, and several more hours at the resort, with pickup at 2:35 p.m. The later arrival in Chicago is 11:48 p.m.
Take the later flight. When there’s a workable choice, I’d rather return in the afternoon or evening and keep part of the last day. The late Chicago arrival is fine here.

I can exchange all three tickets to the 5:40 p.m. nonstop for $267 total and move the prepaid transfer to 2:35 p.m. at no additional charge. The outbound flight, resort dates, and Enterprise reservation will remain untouched. Shall I complete both changes?
Yes. Keep us together if seats are available, but don’t change cabin or add anything else.
There are three adjacent Main Cabin seats, 24D, 24E, and 24F, available at no extra cost. I’ll use those and make no other additions.

Completed. Marcus, Daniel, and Owen are rebooked under American Q7N4PL on the June 27 nonstop departing San Diego at 5:40 p.m. and arriving in Chicago at 11:48 p.m., with seats 24D-24F. The exchange charged $267 total. Transfer SDT-627104 now has a 2:35 p.m. pickup from the Mission Bay resort, with no price change. The June 20 outbound, the full resort stay under MBY-624817, the June 22-25 Enterprise rental, and the arrival transfer were unchanged. The revised San Diego trip total is $6,563.99 before fuel and tips.
